secretLetters.draftLabel: Draft blessing — customizable before final print
secretLetters.body:
My dearest Líng Lëé,

May you find happiness in the little things and brilliance in the big chapters ahead. From Diploma to Degree, thank you for filling our little universe with warmth, poise, and unforgettable laughter.

No matter how far our constellations travel, our table at mamak and our private club remain permanently reserved.

With endless affection,
The Forever Club

secretLetters.draftLabel: Draft blessing — customizable before final print
secretLetters.body:
My dearest Jia Qi,

May your dreams grow bolder, your worries grow lighter, and every room you enter reflect the grace and spirit you bring to us. Thank you for every shared lecture, spontaneous detour, and quiet encouragement from 2022 to 2026.

Here is to our next era — always glowing, always together in spirit.

With endless affection,
The Forever Club

secretLetters.draftLabel: Draft blessing — customizable before final print
secretLetters.body:
My dearest yimin_04,

May life bring you gentle mornings, genuine people, unforgettable travels, and infinite reasons to smile. Thank you for being an irreplaceable star in this four-person cosmos.

Different schedules and new cities will never dim what we built together.

With endless affection,
The Forever Club

timeCapsule.letterTitle: To Kahean, Líng Lëé, Jia Qi & yimin_04 in 2030
timeCapsule.letterBody:
Four Girls. One Universe.

If you are reading this unlocked capsule, years have passed since 2026. Wherever your careers, cities, and lives have carried you, remember the nights we spent dreaming about the future and laughing until late.

Open the group chat today. Plan the next mamak summit. Nothing truly ends when four stars share the same sky.

Est. Forever — The Forever Club

poemLines: Of all the stars in the universe,
but always under the same sky.
